summary: MindForge Inc. (formerly U-BX Technology Ltd.) files a Form 6-K to report a name change and trading symbol change approved at the November 4, 2025 AGM and implemented by directors on July 10, 2026. Effective July 15, 2026, the company's name changes to MindForge Inc. and its Nasdaq symbol changes from UBXG to MF starting July 20, 2026. CUSIP remains unchanged. This is a routine corporate action with no special-situation implications; there are no terms, advisors, or structural changes to analyze. No deal mechanics or risk-arb angle. This is not a special situation.
